name: Princess Moon ~Seihouseki Kishidan no Junan~
original_name: プリンセスムーン　～聖宝石騎士団の受難～
source:
In 1311 hero Olivia and her "St Jewel Knights" friends overthrew the corrupt dynasty and founded a revolutionary government. The other mainland kings tremble in fear at the prospect of revolution shifting to their countries. The knights squadron has one weakness - they are all women. Kings hire a legendary trainer to awaken sexual desire in the commanders of this military unit.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-april-2004-realize.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
1311年，英雄Olivia与“圣宝石骑士团”的同伴推翻腐败王朝，建立革命政府。大陆其他国王害怕革命蔓延到自己的国家，无不战战兢兢。骑士部队存在一个弱点——成员全部是成年女性。国王们雇来一名传奇调教师，企图唤醒这支部队指挥官们的性欲。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-april-2004-realize.html]vndbreview[/url]]
